actions.action: Prune each basil stem back to just above the last set of leaves (leaving ~1/4 inch) once stems reach about six inches
Snip off the tops of bolting/flowering stems (deadheading)
Check basil plants every one to two weeks for stems to cut back
Optionally root basil cuttings to grow new plants

verdict.reason: The answer treats the plant as tall, leggy basil that needs regular pruning above leaf sets to bush out, which matches the confirmed fix, and it contains nothing harmful.
